]

]

    line, = ax.plot([], [], color=family_colors[family], linewidth=2.5, label=family)

                   fancybox=True, title="Model Family", title_fontsize=11)

# Title
fig.suptitle("AI Model Capability Benchmarks — Parallel Coordinates",
             fontsize=16, fontweight="bold", color="#111827", y=0.97)
ax.set_title("Thicker lines = flagship models  |  Adjacent axes highlight key trade-offs",
             fontsize=10, color="#6B7280", pad=12)

# Axis formatting
ax.set_xlim(-0.5, n_axes - 0.5)
ax.set_ylim(25, 108)
ax.set_xticks([])
ax.yaxis.set_visible(False)
for spine in ax.spines.values():
    spine.set_visible(False)

# Unit label
ax.text(-0.45, 103, "Score (0–100)", fontsize=9, color="#6B7280",
        fontstyle="italic", va="bottom")

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.95])
plt.savefig("/app/output/result.png", dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight",
            facecolor="#FAFAFA", edgecolor="none")
print("Chart saved to /app/output/result.png")
